hash_seed_note: These eleven emit a different byte order under a different PYTHONHASHSEED. Pinning the seed makes the build reproducible, which is the floor, not the repair: a real fix is a tiebreak at each sort and a sorted() at each set iteration, as done for build_profiles.py and build_capability_physical.py. Named here so the fragility stays visible.
note: Builders whose committed output they no longer reproduce. Measured by repro_audit.py + the page re-test, both run 11 Sep 2026. `unsafe` means re-running the builder would overwrite a PUBLISHED PAGE with a body that is behind it - runner.py refuses these.

resolved.build_casestudies.py: CLEARED 12 Sep 2026. Its page differed from the builder only in ORDER - identical text as a multiset, nothing lost or gained - because the builder iterates sets and Python randomises string hashing per process. PYTHONHASHSEED is pinned where builders are invoked (runner.py and record_graph.py), the page was rebuilt once onto the defined order, and the text was verified unchanged token for token.

resolved.build_profiles.py: CLEARED 12 Sep 2026. It publishes 61 pages and was behind them in three ways, all now closed: the menu (it emitted an older six-item bar nothing else on the site used), the ORDER of rows inside the country pages (it sorted a set by a score that ties six ways, so the order changed every run), and the numbers (stale against the grown cube). Re-measured after fixing all three: 61 pages, nothing lost - identical text-token multisets, three numbers updated per country page, and countries.html a pure reordering. Verified stable across three consecutive runs.
